description: A fictional stylised low-poly video-game prop in the shape of a rifle, a chunky toy-like cartoon 3D game asset (not a real object, no working parts). A long dark grey main body block with a flat ridged strip along its whole top, a small boxy block standing at the back end of the strip and a small triangular frame standing above the thin front tube near the front end. A straight round dark grey tube sticking out of the front and ending in a chunky cylinder with two side slots. A matte black front cover, octagonal in section, wrapping the rear two thirds of the tube, with three oval slots along its side. Under the main body a matte black handle raked backward, a small curved lever inside a rounded black loop, and in front of the loop a curved matte black box hanging down and forward. At the rear a matte black shoulder piece: a straight bar from the main body to a tall flat end plate with a triangular lower strut. Bright orange accents: the bottom plate of the curved box, a small knob on the left flank of the main body, and a thin band round the front end of the octagonal cover. A small dark grey lever on the left flank above the handle. The right flank is plain.
proportions: About 0.90 m long, 0.07 m wide and 0.26 m tall. (length : width : height = 12.86 : 1 : 3.71)
sides: the small orange knob and the small dark grey lever are on the left flank; the right flank is plain; everything else is symmetric left to right.
